Name: Tsum Tsum Script - ALPHA
Message:
**Changes**
1. Longer chains, with a new "Link reach" setting
2. New skill: Formal Suit Beast
3. Better timing for Cpt. Lightyear
4. "Clear Bubbles" is now a three-way "Bubble Strategy"
5. Settings changes now apply mid-run
6. Settings now shows what will run, and when
7. New "Share settings": copy your setup as a code, or paste someone else's
8. Auto Send Hearts now sweeps your whole ranking
9. Rank-up and record panels no longer hide your score
10. New "Record round stats": every round you play is logged to a spreadsheet
11. Round stats name the tsum played, split by day, and can be shared from the app
12. The floating bar names the tsum being played

_USE WITH CAUTION_
